I really like instances of game mechanics being justified by the game narrative or the setting. I have a few examples here but I'd like to hear some more if you guys know!

Assassin's creed. I was a big fan of the series back in the days. I really enjoyed the games up to Revelations and then it got a bit worse. Crypt of the necrodancer. In this case it's a bit more subtle but I also liked it. For those who don't know about this game, it's a rogue-like rythm-based game (you can only move on the beat).
